title: Owner's rulings for the fix spec android-macos-e2e-fixes (phase 4)
context: Grounding traced every open finding to code. Twelve choices changed what gets built: priorities, the photo placement model, keyboard scope, verification, the reminder model, the text-field naming gap in Flutter's engine, the Edit menu workaround, the dismiss backdrops, the Text size control, clocks, how the work ships, and live probes during spec work.
options: Recommended option on each of the twelve questions

Narrower alternatives (only Blocks as Must; keep composer photo rules; Settings-only keyboard; tests only; ask permission only when the setting is touched; native macOS name workaround; native Edit-menu bridge; name app backdrops; custom slider; only the reminder row follows the system clock; one PR per finding)
outcome: The owner chose the recommended option on all twelve on 2026-09-27; the binding wording is in docs/specs/android-macos-e2e-fixes.decisions.md.U+000AU+002D Must is MB1, MB2, H1, H5 and C8.U+000AU+002D Enter-typed lines are photo stops; this amends composer spec P3, P4 and P6.U+000AU+002D Keyboard focus is app-wide, with a base control and a focus token.U+000AU+002D Verification is tests plus live checks on the Mac and the phone; VoiceOver and TalkBack speech stay owner checks.U+000AU+002D Reminders are scheduled at launch, on resume and after an entry is saved, 7 days ahead, skipping days that already have an entry; permission is asked on first launch; a refusal shows in Settings.U+000AU+002D H6: upstream issue plus persistent names for Search and the photo caption; no native workaround.U+000AU+002D The app builds its own macOS menu bar and maps Ctrl+K and the Emacs-style keys.U+000AU+002D Backdrops keep the earlier accepted rule, so H7 fixes only the sidebar.U+000AU+002D Text size becomes Small, Medium and Large segments.U+000AU+002D Every clock follows the system 12/24-hour setting.U+000AU+002D Shipping: Musts alone, then by area, with keyboard focus last.U+000AU+002D The plain macOS build may be launched for accessibility reads during spec work.
